required_trust_model_phrases: proves control of the exact successor private key for this exact rotation evidence only
does not prove human, device, or legal identity continuity
does not transfer root, capability, revocation, or checkpoint authority
does not resolve a competing rotation fork or select a winning branch
truth_boundary: This guard proves selected repository evidence declarations agree at one commit, including the machine matrix, primary root-gate report, public README count, and the bounded successor-possession truth boundary in TRUST_MODEL.md. It does not prove fixture completeness, documentation completeness, semantic correctness beyond exercised cases, external independence, hostile-environment security, or AXM-wide CANON status.
